name: Ocal Browser v9.8.00 (Stable)
body:
## 🚀 Ocal Browser v9.8.00 (Stable) — Release Notes

### ⚡ Direct GPU Driver Communication & Hardware Acceleration
* **Passthrough Command Decoder**: Directs GL and WebGL draw commands straight to the host graphics driver, bypassing Chromium's validating emulation layer and cutting CPU draw-call latency.
* **Direct3D 11 ANGLE Backend**: Native Direct3D 11 driver communication on Windows for maximum stability and performance across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.
* **Zero-Copy Rasterization & Buffers**: Raster threads write directly to GPU memory buffers (`enable-zero-copy`, `enable-native-gpu-memory-buffers`), eliminating intermediate CPU-to-GPU memory copies for 60/120+ FPS fluid compositing.
* **DirectComposition & Hardware Overlays**: Direct hardware presentation to Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) swap chains and hardware overlays without software compositing overhead.
* **Hardware Video Decode & Encode**: Accelerated video pipelines for 4K/60FPS streaming, WebM, H.264, HEVC, and AV1 (`D3D11VideoDecoder`, `PlatformHEVCDecoderSupport`).
* **High-Throughput Caching**: Configured 512 MB disk cache and 256 MB streaming media cache for instant asset loading and stutter-free buffering.

### 🧩 Extension Store Overhaul (`ocal://store`)
* **Minimalist Design System**: Completely redesigned without gradients or heavy shadows to match the clean aesthetic of the Home Page.
* **Refined Bento Layout**: Clean grid layout with category navigation, instant search filtering, and sleek install pills.
* **Unified Theme Integration**: Perfect light/dark mode alignment with real-time accent color synchronization.

### 🤖 AI Sidebar Refinements
* **Flush Seamless Fit**: Reduced the left sidebar gap by eliminating dead space, cleanly aligning the AI card against the browser window.
* **Streamlined UI**: Removed the resize handle and mouse drag logic to prevent accidental edge resizing and maintain a clean layout.

### 🎨 Omnibox Shield Contrast & Theme Fix
* **Perceptual Contrast Calculation**: Fixed text and icon colors inside the omnibox shield pill (`#shield-status`, `#page-time-chip`) to dynamically adjust based on accent luminance (crisp white text on purple/dark accents, dark text on bright lime).
* **Removed Hardcoded Colors**: Stripped hardcoded `#000` from page timing chips and ensured child icons/spans inherit dynamic theme contrast.

### 📄 PDF Viewer, File Manager & Audio Polish
* **Compact PDF App Bar**: Compact browser chrome layout with modern page controls and navigation.
* **Bento File Manager**: Refined file navigation, quick filters, and clean preview handling.
* **Volume Booster & Shield Popups**: Anchored shield popups directly under the omnibox pill and added blur grace periods to the volume booster.

### 📦 Packaging & Installer
* Updated Inno Setup installer script to v9.8.00 with Windows 11 DWM rounded frame integration.
